career_ladder.note: Career progression for school education teachers in the Tamil Nadu Elementary Educational Subordinate Service and Tamil Nadu School Educational Subordinate Service. exam_scheme.note: Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test (TNTET) is conducted by the Teachers Recruitment Board (TRB) in accordance with the statutory guidelines formulated by the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) and G.O. (Ms) No. 181, School Education (C2) Department. It comprises two distinct papers: Paper I (for teachers of Classes I to V) and Paper II (for teachers of Classes VI to VIII). Both papers contain 150 objective multiple-choice questions of 1 mark each with no negative marking.

Language I (Tamil / Telugu / Malayalam / Kannada / Urdu)

papers.qualifying_threshold: Overall qualifying mark for Paper I: 60% (90 marks) for General/OC; 55% (82 marks) for BC, BCM, MBC/DNC, SC, SCA, ST, and PwD (total 150 marks)

Language I (Tamil / Telugu / Malayalam / Kannada / Urdu)

papers.qualifying_threshold: Overall qualifying mark for Paper II: 60% (90 marks) for General/OC; 55% (82 marks) for BC, BCM, MBC/DNC, SC, SCA, ST, and PwD (total 150 marks)

financial_package.note: TNTET is an eligibility test qualifying candidates for recruitment as Secondary Grade Teachers (Level 10: ₹20,600 - ₹75,900) and Graduate Teachers / B.T. Assistants (Level 16: ₹36,400 - ₹1,34,200) under the Tamil Nadu Revised Pay Rules, 2017. Financial figures represent baseline entry emoluments for appointed Secondary Grade Teachers.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Tamil Nadu Revised Pay Rules, 2017 & TRB Teacher Recruitment Notifications (Scale of Pay Level 10: Rs. 20,600 - 75,900)
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimate assumes baseline Level 10 entry basic pay ₹20,600 with 58% DA (effective 1 Jul 2025) plus Tamil Nadu Grade-classified HRA (₹1,200 to ₹3,000), Medical Allowance, and City Compensatory Allowance. Deductions include CPS (10% of Basic+DA), NHIS, and professional tax.
official_perks: Medical insurance coverage under New Health Insurance Scheme (NHIS) for school teachers and eligible family members
Earned leave, medical leave, and vacation leave as per Tamil Nadu School Education Leave Rules
Government accommodation / quarters or station HRA according to city/rural tier
Festival advance and annual Pongal bonus sanctioned for state teachers
Contributory Pension Scheme (CPS/NPS) with state government matching contribution

competition_benchmarks.note: TNTET witnesses substantial participation from D.El.Ed and B.Ed holders across Tamil Nadu. Benchmarks are verified directly from official TRB Tamil Nadu press releases certifying the candidate appearance statistics for Paper I and Paper II.

years.selectivity_ratio: 96.22% overall attendance (220,464 candidates appeared out of 229,129 registered across Paper I and Paper II)
years.source_label: TRB Tamil Nadu Press News dated 07.07.2026: Paper I (04.07.2026): 61,386 registered, 59,535 appeared across 222 centres (96.99%); Paper II (05.07.2026): 1,67,743 registered, 1,60,929 appeared across 613 centres (95.94%)
